title: Custom GPT action namespace missing getRelationshipSignals after schema refresh
summary: User tested the prompt: 'Do not describe legacy RB concepts. Tell me which RB actions you can actually call right now. Then call getRelationshipSignals.' The assistant responded that no RB-native actions were exposed and listed only generic platform tools such as Gmail, Google Calendar, file_search, web, automations, api_tool, python, bio, and user_settings. It could not call getRelationshipSignals.
observed_issue: The active GPT session appears not to have the RB Custom GPT Action namespace loaded at all. This is not just a missing getRelationshipSignals operation; the session reported no RB-native actions available.

defects.title: Active GPT session does not expose RB action namespace
defects.description: The assistant reported no callable RB-native actions and listed only generic platform tools. This indicates the test was run in a session/GPT configuration where the RB Custom GPT Actions were not loaded, not merely that a specific operation was missing.
defects.recommendation: Verify the user is testing inside the saved Relationship Bridge 9.0 Custom GPT, not a normal ChatGPT/Codex chat. In GPT Builder, ensure Actions are enabled, schema uses system/api/openapi_gpt.yaml, auth header x-api-key is configured, the GPT is saved, and the test is run in a fresh chat opened from that GPT. If still failing, delete and recreate the Action rather than editing in place.

raw_text: User provided the exact failed response: 'I do not currently have callable RB-native actions exposed as tools in this session...' It listed Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Contacts, file_search, web, automations, canmore, api_tool, python, bio, user_settings, and said it could not truthfully execute getRelationshipSignals/getDailyBrief/touchContact/closeLoop/startRB/showTraceLog.
